summary: Suncrete, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of 100% of Hope Concrete, LLC and its subsidiaries for aggregate consideration including 220,007 shares of Class A common stock to Michael Mikytuck, 69,511 shares of nonvoting Class B common stock of a subsidiary exchangeable for 695,110 Class A shares to Foley Bros., and a net cash payment of approximately $39.4 million. The acquisition closed on April 28, 2026. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The structure involves rollover equity and an exchange agreement. Watch for post-closing adjustments and integration risk; potential dilution from exchangeable shares may affect value.
